## Lessons learned

1. HeartFlow think() is unsuitable for fact-checking calculation/narrative tasks — returns "不知道，缺少关键信息" (confidence 0.3) by design. Use static probe scripts + single-claim checks instead.
2. Quantum/cryptography sections benefit from concrete regulatory deadlines (EO 14412, CNSA 2.0, NIST FIPS 203/204/205) — they anchor the "cryptographic singularity" narrative in actionable policy.
3. Humanoid robot section is now credible enough to support market-size forecasts ($1.21B → $4.98B) with specific company milestones.
4. Digital twin / consciousness section has moved from pure philosophy to engineering roadmaps (IBS, EU, arXiv master plan) — this is a genuine 2026 shift.
5. Military enhancement section now has battlefield evidence (Ukraine Hypershell) + market data + AR helmet contracts — three independent signal types.
